evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Arden: 'So I'm just gonna gather details about the move, sir. So we can put up accurate estimate that might take around ten to fifteen minutes. evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing ('So this is for a two bedroom apartment...') with no prior question about customer's concerns or what they want answered on the call.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Apartment (property type), second floor with elevator (floor/stories), items listed (TV, dining table, king bed, twin beds), box count (10–12 boxes), walking distances (50 ft apartment to elevator, 30 ft elevator to truck), destination is two-story house with customer taking two bedrooms. evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Arden: 'Okay, now let's talk about boxes. How many total number of boxes are we going to move for you?' — Customer responds '10 to 12.'

evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Not mentioned. No reference to discount or on-time guarantee.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Not mentioned. No reference to $2,000 coverage or No Worries Damage Coverage.

evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep does not ask 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or equivalent.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No question like 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep does not say 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any direct ask for the business. Instead, rep says 'I have availability for Friday. evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Not mentioned. No reference to rate lock or no-deposit terms.

Only 3 of 6 items confirmed.

top_strength: Arden gathered all critical logistics details systematically and thoroughly (property type, floor, items, walking distances, box count, destination rooms), which is the foundation of an accurate estimate.
coaching_note: Skip Section 2 entirely (Their Agenda, Two Layers Deep) — jump straight to logistics probing — and then abandon Sections 5, 6, and 7 (Two Promises, final concerns, explicit ask for business, booking confirmation); these omissions make the call incomplete and prevent any real opportunity to close. Deliver the full call sequence in order.
